forum.title: Integration of xcube Cryptolib for STM32F303RE
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @hegde\_08 ,

Which toolchain are you using?

I recommend you to look at these articles:

[How to add external libraries in STM32CubeIDE - STMicroelectronics Community](https://community.st.com/t5/stm32-mcus/how-to-add-external-libraries-in-stm32cubeide/ta-p/628619)

[How to add external libraries in Keil® MDK-ARM: An example using X-CUBE-CRYPTOLIB... - STMicroelectronics Community.](https://community.st.com/t5/stm32-mcus/how-to-add-external-libraries-in-keil-mdk-arm-an-example-using-x/ta-p/646624)

The main objective of these articles is to describe the steps for integrating an external library like as X-CUBE-CRYPTOLIB.

Thank you.

Kaouthar
forum.content_text: I am trying to integrate Crypto lib to NUCLEOF303RE Board, Any guide or any suggestions would help

scraped_replies.html: In addition to what @KDJEM.1 said and the article provided (treating a product having Cortex-M3),  STM32F303 MCU has Cortex-M4 so you need to use the cryptographic library related to Cortex-M4 which is libSTM32Cryptographic_CM4.a.
